result.stdout:
Usage: dotnet benchmark [--project <path>] [--assembly <path>] [harness-options...]

Tool options:
  --project <path>    Build and benchmark a .NET project (.csproj or directory)
  --assembly <path>   Benchmark a specific assembly (.dll). Repeatable.

All BenchmarkHarness flags pass through unchanged:
  --filter, --samples, --warmup-samples, --reporter, --output, --confidence,
  --significance-level, --outlier, --auto-tune, --ops-per-sample, --ci-target,
  --min-samples, --max-samples, --min-warmup-samples, --max-warmup-samples,
  --max-tuning-time, --list, --dry-run, --in-process, --order, --seed,
  --detail, --max-regression-percent, --gc, --force-gc, --no-allocations, --help

See https://docs.nbenchmark.net for the full CLI reference.
